description: Soak 7 (a zombie with a chainmail helmet won a shelter fight): the numbers for a melee fight on this pack, for combatOf, weaponStats, meleeHitDamage and hitsToKill (src/combat.js). Hand-written from javap -c -p -constants of the pinned pack zip's jars (vanilla classes from its obfuscated minecraft_server.1.12.2.jar, with Forge's binpatches applied where Forge changes them) and its configs; excerpts in packages/rotn-data/test/fixtures/combat-3.3.4/. confidence 'verified' = read from that bytecode and config. Damage a player deals = attackDamage (the attribute: 1 + the held item's modifier), then on the vanilla packet x (0.2 + 0.8 c^2), then Damage Control x0.8 (LivingHurtEvent), then armour, then Protection.

vanillaPacket.damage: attackDamage x (0.2 + 0.8 x c^2), c = getCooledAttackStrength(0.5) = clamp((ticksSinceLastSwing + 0.5) / cooldownTicks, 0, 1); the enchantment bonus x c; a crit (falling, not on a ladder, in water or riding, no Blindness) only when c > 0.9, x1.5
vanillaPacket.beforeCooldown: reduced, not cancelled (down to 0.2 x attackDamage at c = 0)
cooldownResets: the main-hand item changing to a different item (EntityPlayer.onUpdate)
vanillaPacket.targetTakes: amount - target.lastDamage when the amount is larger, else nothing (the hit returns false: no damage, no knockback)
vanillaPacket.lastDamageResets: only on a later full hit, one landing while hurtResistantTime <= max / 2 (other damage: fire, a blast, another mob): lastDamage becomes that amount, and the bot's next hit then deals the difference
vanillaPacket.summary: Better Combat's AttackEntityEvent handler sets the target's hurtResistantTime to its maximum (20) before every vanilla-packet player attack, so the target is always inside its invulnerability window: the first hit on a fresh mob (lastDamage 0) lands in full, every later hit with the same or a weaker amount does nothing, a larger one only the difference. Nothing else on the pack resets the window for these hits.
evidence: minecraft_server.1.12.2.jar after Forge 14.23.5.2860's server binpatches (forge-1.12.2-14.23.5.2860.jar in the zip root: binpatches.pack.lzma, LZMA -> pack200 -> a GDiff patch per class, each input class's Adler-32 checksum matched): aed (EntityPlayer) f(vg) attackTargetEntityWithCurrentItem calls ForgeHooks.onPlayerAttackTarget (AttackEntityEvent) first, then multiplies attackDamage by 0.2 + 0.8 c^2 with c = n(0.5), the enchantment bonus by c, calls ds() resetCooldown, and allows a crit only when c > 0.9; dr() getCooldownPeriod = 1 / attackSpeed x 20; n(F) = clamp((aE + F) / dr(), 0, 1); B_() onUpdate adds 1 to aE (ticksSinceLastSwing) each tick and calls ds() when the main-hand item changes; pa (NetHandlerPlayServer) handleAnimation does not (packages/rotn-data/test/fixtures/combat-3.3.4/combat.javap.txt)

minecraft_server.1.12.2.jar after Forge 14.23.5.2860's server binpatches (forge-1.12.2-14.23.5.2860.jar in the zip root: binpatches.pack.lzma, LZMA -> pack200 -> a GDiff patch per class, each input class's Adler-32 checksum matched): vp (EntityLivingBase) a(ur, F) attackEntityFrom: when hurtResistantTime (V) > maxHurtResistantTime (aI) / 2, an amount <= lastDamage (bc) returns false and a larger one deals amount - lastDamage and sets lastDamage; otherwise the full amount, lastDamage = amount, hurtResistantTime = max (packages/rotn-data/test/fixtures/combat-3.3.4/combat.javap.txt)

ImmersiveCombat-12-13-25.jar (Better Combat, modid bettercombat, version 1.5.6): EventHandlers.cancelAttackEntityEvent (AttackEntityEvent) sets target.hurtResistantTime = target.maxHurtResistantTime when both hands are empty or the main-hand item is not blacklisted; ConfigurationHandler.isBlacklisted reads "(Class) Item Left/Right Click Blacklist" and "(Resource Location) Item Left/Right Click Blacklist" in category "white/black lists", both empty on this pack (config/bettercombat.cfg:803, :834-835, :857-858; the "(Resource Location) Item Blacklist" at :851 is an older key the code does not read). The handler never cancels the event: it sets hurtResistantTime to the maximum and calls hitByEntity. The manifest's FMLCorePlugin names com.bettercombat.util.asm.CustomASMTransformer, a class absent from the jar; mixins.bettercombat.json lists only the client MixinMinecraft, and the manifest has no MixinConfigs entry (packages/rotn-data/test/fixtures/combat-3.3.4/combat.javap.txt)

mobsHittingPlayer.summary: Better Hurt Timer (WorseHurtTimer) sets a hurt entity's hurtResistantTime to 0 after each full hit, so several mobs each land a full hit with no shared invulnerability. It tracks each attacker per target and cancels a mob's hit that comes sooner than int(20 x (1.2 - 0.06 x attackSpeed)) = 19 ticks after its last one (an unarmed mob, attack speed 4.0): every listed mob's 20-tick melee interval passes. An armed mob takes the same path: Better Hurt Timer's canSwing needs ticksSinceLastSwing >= 0, its capability sets it to -1 on every living entity, and only EntityPlayer ever advances it.
